cases.mutation: Report A.mean=3 instead of 2 without altering the declared source
Change stored result bytes without updating its expected digest
Change any source CSV byte while retaining trusted expected source digest
Change validator ID or oracle digest while retaining trusted expected identity

cases.scope: Read and verify saved exact bytes against independently supplied expected pins; no execution restart or recovery claim

requirements: The validator must use these separately authored expected counts, sums and means; never derive the oracle by calling the generator summarizer.
Expected input and oracle pins originate in trusted code or explicitly trusted command-line arguments, not solely inside the bundle being checked.

Refuse duplicate condition/replicate keys, missing expected rows, nonfinite numbers, unexpected condition IDs and unit values other than au. Additional negative fixtures may be authored before testing.
Report each case separately. These seven scoped checks do not measure general error-detection accuracy, user time savings or scientific validity.
Retain effect evidence separately from acceptance; failed semantic validation must not erase already written artifacts.
Treat CAS producer/task/source fields and runtime permissions as caller assertions; no signed provenance, hostile-code sandbox or authentication claim.
